book.name: Hibluu-to
book.title: Kaapiya la vu hil bel-ate sen lavand Hibluu-to

content: Anutu hako yiiy lom-ato ond manyinjo va bopaata ti keen
Om vakasin sen yiiy hangoyin-ato ond yakangg bu be yiiy oo naapuvu niwêêk, de yame yanitambo jak-ambe yiiy gavuuh na le.

+ o 2:2 Gal 3:19*In bôôy ond Anutu vu vakasin vu angela-so be lanêêl langaah, tombe vakasin-anju ond nôôn keen, om hil pin sen nanyend doos-ambe sil kalêêh vakasin-anjuuto ond lako nipaya nyevahaan ak.

+ o 2:3 Hiblu 10:29; 12:25*Lemu gêên ond Anutu hako yiiy lom, tombe manyinjo va bopaata ti keen lôôt, om naambe yiiy galuuh damingg vu va bopaataa-ju ond yale napak in yate nipaya nyevahaan-ambe yana tana? Malis. Yik Omaaho Bop oo nêêl vakasin munggin nambe le gako yiiy nom, tombe hil sen lango yite vakasin-anjuuto ond lanêêl langaah vu yiiy nambe vakasin-anju keen lôôt.

+ o 2:4 Mak 16:20; 1Ko 12:4,11*Tonde yik Anutu yoo kaandu vakasin-anju lak sen vu niwêêk vu yite hil-ambe lawiing taahu taahu ngeeyaata osin niwêêk, osin hatiiy Vavi Vaambuung-ate niwêêk kul-ate nyemalis amu vu hil lohvu yoo ahe having-ato.
Yesu tu yate omaaho sen hako yiiy lom-ato danggakook keen
Kul sen ganggin omaahonôôn nohvu taaku pin sen yiiy nakaas in-anjo, ond Anutu me-vu kul-anjo lukala angela-so namand e, malis.
+ o 2:6 Saam 8:4-6*In omaaho ti kaavu boow ti neep hôôk kaapiya be nêêl langaah nambe,

content.text: “O Anutu, omaahonôôn ond sil vaati ondeey gakam navu sil? De omaahonôôn noondin ond sil vaati ondeey onanggin sil nivasa?
Le sim olaanggôôl omaahonôôn-ambe haalend pasiv de angela-so haalend bop savok omaahonôôn la daka, le ma de gavu nikaapulis osin haalend bop vu sil-ambe mem ohako sil lak,
+ o 2:8 1Ko 15:27*tonde gawiing-ambe va pin lahulis sil vaalu kambi in nambe sil oo ganggin pin.”

content: Keen, Anutu hatung va pin lahulis omaahonôôn baambu, de me-havuuh vati be nando malis in nambe me-gulis baambu le, lemu gêên yaahe nambe va pin-ame lahulis omaahonôôn baambu le, malis.

+ o 2:9 Pil 2:8-9*Nganjo Yesu ond mem, in yaahe nambe Anutu laanggôôl Yesu be haale pasiv de angela-so haalend bop savok yi daka vêêl e, tombe hako nivaane be yimb, le sim gêên Anutu hako yi lak-ambe vu va nikaapulis-ate vu yi, osin wiing-ambe haale tu bopaata lak. Keen, Anutu-te samu samu bopaata ondeey Yesu yimb in dôôvu hil pin.

+ o 2:10 Lom 11:36*De Anutu sen yoo hatung va pin-ambe va pin danggakook yii-to, ond nawiingin nambe naanggiiy hil ngeeyaata lana vu yi in sil daatu yite noow-aso be gako yite nikaapulis. Om yoo wiing va lohvu be vu nivaane vu Yesu, tombe nivaanêê-ju wiing-ambe Yesu tu omaaho nyemalu nivasa nôôn in nambe gako sil nom.

+ o 2:11 Mat 25:40; Mak 3:35; Jon 20:17*Ke, Yesuu-ju nawiing-ambe hil datu vaambuung, tombe yoo having hil pin sen nawiing-ambe sil datu vaambuung-ato, ond sil ahondoos pin maandin timu, ondeey Yesu nanêêl sil nambe yite halindin, de me-yi sil nambe va malis-ambe natu ka in sil e.
+ o 2:12 Saam 22:22*Tonde nêêl nambe,

content.text: “O Anutu, sale naanêêl ohaalem langaah vu sa halingg-aso. Keen, sale aambiing laalo in sa gako ohaalem jak dôôk hil bel-ate lavuun.”

content: + o 2:13 Ais 8:17-18*De yik nêêl ango laah nambe,

content.text: “Sa longgpayo le na timu vu Anutu keen.”

content: Tonde sim nêêl ti laah nambe,

content.text: “Angge, sa de sate unoopasiv-aso sen Anutu

content: Yesu tu omaahonôôn keen in nambe dôôvu yiiy

+ o 2:14 Jon 12:31; 1Jon 3:8; Taato 12:10*Om unoopasiv-asôônju ond sil omaahonôôn, tombe yik Yesu tu omaahonôôn-ambe ni nambe sil having. Wiing nambêênju in nambe yoo jimb, tombe yite yimbin-anju daanggôôl Saalang sen yite niwêêk neep-ambe nayiis hil dayimb-ato na.
In omaahonôôn dayêênin yimbin, tombe lak busin pin sen dando voon-anjôôto ond niyenin-anjo nanduuh sil tatin, om Yesu yimb in nambe nôôh sil vêêl in niyenin-anju.
+ o 2:16 Ais 41:8-9*Keen lôôt, me-nawiing in nambe dôôvu angela-so le, nganjo nawiing in nambe dôôvu hil sen silate danggakook neep vu Abalaam-ato.

+ o 2:17 Pil 2:7; Hiblu 2:14; 1Jon 2:2; 4:10*Nambêênju ondeey yoo tu ni nambe halindin-asôôto keen, in nambe mem naatu yêêv bop salivangin-ate be yoo ka pasiv in omaahonôôn osin biing Anutu-te kul nivasa lôôt, tombe yik yoo gatung yi naatu salivangin in kawiiy hil-ate nipaya na.
+ o 2:18 Hiblu 4:15*De yoo hako nivaane pin sen tovu yi be sahi yii-to, om yik yoo lohvu nambe dôôvu hil sen sahisin natovu sil-ato.
